title: rorippa dubia var. benghalensis
intro: Rorippa dubia var. benghalensis, commonly known as Indian cress, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Indian cress are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids that exhibit antimicrobial, anticancer, and hepatoprotective activities. Further research is required to fully elucidate the bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions of Rorippa dubia var. benghalensis.
